title: Thor: Seireioukiden
overview:
Many years have passed since the "war" between the Spirit King and the demon long ago. Guided by fate, Leon's journey to become the next Spirit King begins...

Command six spirits of different elements, master a wide variety of actions and five types of weapons, and stand up to attacking enemies and all kinds of traps!

遥か昔に起こった精霊王と魔人の「戦い」から幾年月。
運命に導かれ、次代の精霊王となるべくレオンの旅が始まる…。

属性が異なる6体の精霊を従え、多彩なアクションと5タイプの武器を使いこなして襲いかかる敵やさまざまな仕掛けに立ち向かえ!
